scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,backend,frontend -c magenta,blue,green "npm run db:up" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n db,backend,frontend -c magenta,blue,green "npm run db:up" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:all: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run dev
scripts.start:all: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run start
